entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the item?
It's the new performance jersey I bought. I was so excited for it, but it's the wrong size. I tried it on once and it's just way too tight. I can barely breathe in it.
Okay, so it's a sizing issue, not a defect with the jersey itself. I understand. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF8675309. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I saved up for this. I really needed the money back if it wasn't going to work out.
I appreciate your loyalty, and I'll do my best to help. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the jersey was delivered about 65 days ago.
Is... is that a problem? I just got so busy and...

Not at all. Our policy for standard items is a 90-day return window, so you're well within that timeframe. I can absolutely process this for you. We can do a full refund, or if you'd like, I can set up an exchange for the correct size.
Oh, really? That's a huge relief! Thank you so much, Sarah. An exchange would be perfect. I'd love to get the jersey in a size up.

You got it. I've just initiated the exchange process. You'll receive an email in the next few minutes with a pre-paid return label to send back the jersey that's too tight. As soon as we see that it's been scanned by the carrier, we'll ship out the new size to you. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's everything. You've been incredibly helpful. Thank you!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
